description:
Egans are delighted to present this attractive three-bedroom semi-detached property to the open market for sale. Recently renovated to a high standard throughout, this well-presented home offers bright, spacious and versatile accommodation, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers, families or those seeking a comfortable home in a convenient location.

The accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hallway, sitting room, open-plan kitchen/living area, three bedrooms, main family bathroom and utility room. This modern property boasts an impressive A3 BER rating and benefits from an air-to-water heat pump with underfloor heating, providing an efficient and comfortable heating solution.

Externally, the property benefits from a large, secure rear garden, providing excellent outdoor space for family use, entertaining or relaxation.

The property has been carefully upgraded and modernised throughout, offering prospective purchasers the opportunity to acquire a turnkey home with little or nothing left to do.

Located c. 2km from Tyrrellspass, Co. Westmeath, the property is ideally positioned within easy reach of local amenities and services, while also providing convenient access to surrounding towns and major transport links. The M4 and M6 motorways are easily accessible, making commuting to Dublin or the West within easy reach.

Viewing of this property is highly recommended and is strictly by appointment through Egans.
